## 10/15/2026 - Using BCF tools and working with VCF

-   **Working Directory**

    `/gpfs1/cl/biol3990/PopulationGenomics/VCF`

    **Input Files**

    -   `Lottia_gigantea_pl_flt3.renamed.vcf.gz`

    **Output Files**

    **Programs and Dependenceis**

-   `VACC linux server (bash)`

-   

    **Scripts**

-   `#!/bin/bash`

    `#SBATCH --job-name=vcf_stats`

    `#SBATCH --partition=general`

    `#SBATCH --nodes=1`

    `#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1`

    `#SBATCH --mem=40G`

    `#SBATCH --time=30:00:00`

    `#SBATCH --output=./logs/%x.%j.out`

    `#SBATCH --error=./logs/%x.%j.err`

    `#SBATCH --mail-type=ALL`

    `#SBATCH --mail-user=NETID@uvm.edu`

    `module load gcc`

    `module load vcftools`

    `##set your path to where the data is, change to your own path!!`

    `INDIR="/users/d/s/dsadler1/scratch/EcolGenom2026/PopulationGenomics26/mydata"`

    `##set your path to where the data will be stored, change to your own path!!`

    `OUTDIR="/users/d/s/dsadler1/scratch/EcolGenom2026/PopulationGenomics26/myresults"`

    `##change to directory where data is`

    `cd $INDIR`

    `##change out directory to where the results will go`

    `vcftools --gzvcf Lottia_gigantea_pl_flt3.renamed.vcf.gz --missing-indv --out $OUTDIR/missing_data`

    `vcftools --gzvcf Lottia_gigantea_pl_flt3.renamed.vcf.gz --depth --out $OUTDIR/depth_data`

    **Code**

    `load <MODULE>, bcftools xxx greb -v`
